claims.text: Keep ear dry; topical ear drops in most cases
claims.quote: All patients should take precautions to keep the ear dry, use topical ear drops in most cases, and take pain medication as needed.

claims.text: Aminoglycoside or fluoroquinolone (eg, ciprofloxacin) drops w a steroid (eg, dexamethasone): effective
claims.quote: Aminoglycoside and fluoroquinolone topical agents, such as ciprofloxacin, combined with steroids like dexamethasone ear drops, are effective treatment options.
